result.title: Quantifying out-of-distribution data severity with Wasserstein distances: benchmarking large language models for alloy property prediction
result.summary: As general-purpose Large Language Models (LLMs), such as Gemini and DeepSeek, exhibit increasingly advanced reasoning capabilities, a critical question arises: how do their property prediction abilities compare to those of domain-specific pretrained materials models? In this study, we evaluate predictions for Ti, steels, high-entropy alloy (HEA) and Al, demonstrating that general-purpose LLMs surprisingly outperform SteelBERT, MatSciBERT, and SciBERT. To further enhance performance, we introduce a hybrid approach that utilizes numerical priors from a prior model, such as CatBoost or SteelBERT, to guide the general LLMs (Deepseek V3.1, Gemini-2.5-Flash). By inputting these initial estimates from a prior model as prompts, the LLM acts as a reasoning corrector, achieving accuracy superior to the prior model and "unguided mode". Furthermore, we investigate the impact of data strategy using a similarity-based metric, revealing that data quality dominates quantity; using merely 5% of high-similarity reference data of training set as input yields performance similar to the results of using 100% of training set. Additionally, the LLMs demonstrate excellent uncertainty calibration, where self-reported "high" confidence strongly correlates with minimal deviation from ground truth. Our findings suggest that synergizing general-purpose LLMs with prior model numerical baselines and high-quality data curation creates a cost-effective and accurate paradigm for materials discovery, reducing the need for expensive domain-specific pretraining.

AI.brief_summary: 该文以 Ti、钢、高熵合金与 Al 的性能预测为任务，比较通用 LLM 与材料领域预训练模型，并提出用 CatBoost、SteelBERT 等先验模型的数值估计作为提示，让 LLM 充当「推理纠错器」，同时用基于相似度的指标衡量数据选择与 OOD 严重程度。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文是纯文本材料属性回归与数据策展评估，虽涉及置信度校准与「推理纠错」，但不涉及视觉证据、内部 latent 状态或推理步数/停止决策，与 LVR 主线无实质联系，也缺少值得核查的方法迁移线索。
